title: With Same-Day Delivery, Setting Up T-Mobile’s 5G Home Internet Has Never Been Easier: Here’s How
summary: No appointments or technicians are needed for this setup.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Are you looking for more affordable home internet? With plans starting as low as $35 per month* , T-Mobile is offering  the fastest 5G home internet — now with same day delivery, powered by DoorDash — so you can get connected without breaking the bank. Not only are you able to enjoy fast speeds at a low price, but now through their partnership with DoorDash, customers can have their T-Mobile 5G Home Internet kit delivered the same day and be ready to set it up in no time.

Once you have the kit in hand, setting up the device is truly plug and play. The install for home internet is as simple as plugging in one single cord, no appointments or technicians needed. After powering on the device, download the T-Life app and follow the prompts to get your home Wi-Fi running in minutes. The device will convert the 5G signal to Wi-Fi and provide a Wi-Fi signal throughout your home. With a quick, easy set up, you can go from box to streaming in 15 minutes.

Now that you’re connected, you can reap the many benefits on the T-Life app, including weekly T-Mobile Tuesdays rewards, which gets you discounted movie tickets, exclusive restaurant promos and more freebies. On the app, users can also enjoy even more Magenta Status perks, including discounted concert tickets and streaming subscriptions to Netflix and Hulu.

*with AutoPay and voice. Plus, taxes and fees.

** Exclusions like taxes and fees apply.
